newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly higher in thin trade.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed slightly higher at 1,039.40 after a day of quiet trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.

It was the fifth consecutive day that the peso edged higher and the first time since August 22 that the currency, which gained 70 centavos from Friday's close, ended at fewer than 1,040 to the dollar.
Dealers said a scattering of dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters helped the peso hold firm in Monday's trade.
They said the peso traded in a 1,038.55 to 1,041.50 range and reported 159 trades for a lower-than-average $63 million.
